mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.menu_name AS menuName, m.parent_id AS parentId, m.order_num AS orderNum, m.path, m.component, m.menu_type AS menuType, m.perms, m.icon, m.status, m.del_flag AS delFlag, m.create_time AS createTime, m.update_time AS updateTime FROM menu m INNER JOIN role_menu rm ON m.id = rm.menu_id WHERE rm.role_id = #{roleId} AND m.status = '1' AND m.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY m.order_num
